description: AbstractEnforcement.java defines an abstract class for enforcement logic in a Java-based actor system, handling authorization, error reporting, and message passing within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AbstractEnforcement
classes.description: Abstract class providing enforcement logic for authorization, error handling, and message passing in an actor system.

methods.name: enforce
methods.description: Abstract method to perform enforcement, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: enforceSafely
methods.description: Performs enforcement with error handling, ensuring the future always succeeds.

methods.name: convertError
methods.description: Converts a Throwable into a DittoRuntimeException, handling CompletionException causes.

methods.name: handleEnforcementCompletion
methods.description: Handles completion of enforcement, tagging success or failure and managing result.

methods.name: reportUnexpectedErrorOrResponse
methods.description: Reports an error or unknown response, wrapping in appropriate exception.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Logs and wraps errors, returning a DittoRuntimeException.

methods.name: reportUnexpectedError
methods.description: Logs unexpected errors and maps them to external exceptions.

methods.name: reportUnknownResponse
methods.description: Logs unknown responses and creates a GatewayInternalErrorException.

methods.name: mapToExternalException
methods.description: Maps non-DittoRuntimeException errors to GatewayInternalErrorException.

methods.name: addEffectedReadSubjectsToThingSignal
methods.description: Extends a signal with subject headers based on enforcer permissions.

methods.name: isAskTimeoutException
methods.description: Checks if response or error is an AskTimeoutException.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for asking entity shard regions.

methods.name: entityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID with resource type from context.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Returns a diagnostic logging adapter, optionally with correlation ID from headers.

methods.name: pubSubMediator
methods.description: Returns the Akka pubsub mediator actor reference.

methods.name: self
methods.description: Returns the actor reference of the current enforcement actor.

methods.name: sender
methods.description: Returns the actor reference of the message sender.

methods.name: signal
methods.description: Returns the message signal of type T.

methods.name: withMessageToReceiver
methods.description: Creates a new context with a message and receiver set.

methods.name: withMessageToReceiverViaAskFuture
methods.description: Creates a context with a message, receiver, and an ask future with error handling.

methods.name: withMessageToReceiver (overload)
methods.description: Creates a context with a message, receiver, and a wrapper function applied before sending.

methods.name: withoutReceiver
methods.description: Creates a context with no receiver, only a message.

methods.name: dittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders from the current signal.

methods.name: conciergeForwarder
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef of the ConciergeForwarderActor.

methods.name: handleExceptionally
methods.description: Handles a Throwable by sending a DittoRuntimeException to the sender.
